_about: Side quests in the open world (Quests). Every person and line here is original. 'at' is a point on the quest's island in that island's own metres (its clearing is the origin). 'requires' is a story chapter or another quest that must be done first. Types: gather (find 'count' of an item around the island), defeat (waves of foes at 'at'), duel (one named foe at 'at'), deliver (talk to 'to' on another island).

quests.name: Thrown and Forgotten
quests.objective: Find the first-years' practice kunai around Emberwood

intro.text: The first-years threw their practice kunai into the woods. Every last one.
Six are missing. Find them before the head instructor counts the rack.

outro.text: All six, and not a scratch on them. Better than the first-years manage.

quests.name: Trouble at the Old Pier
quests.objective: Drive the bandits off the south shore

intro.text: Bandits on my pier again. They take the catch and laugh about it.
They camp on the south shore. You're Academy, aren't you? Chase them off.

outro.text: Gone! Come by at dawn some day. The first fish of the morning is yours.

quests.name: Red Leaf Remedy
quests.objective: Gather red-leaf herbs across Autumn Wood

intro.text: Shinobi always come to me bleeding. Today you can help me instead.
Red-leaf grows all over this wood. Five bundles will keep my shelves full.

outro.text: Lovely. Now try not to need any of it.

quests.name: Thieves in the Maples
quests.objective: Stop the herb thieves in the western maples

intro.text: Someone has been stripping the red-leaf before it can grow back.
Wind users, by the cuts. They hide in the maples to the west.

outro.text: The wood will grow back now. So will my patience.

intro.text: So you're the one who walked out of the pass alive.
Stories get told. I'd like to see if this one is true.

outro.text: Ha. True after all. Go on, before I want a second round.

quests.name: Holding Back the Flood
quests.objective: Recover the warding seals torn from the old dam

intro.text: The storm tore the warding seals off the dam and scattered them.
Four of them. Without them, the next storm takes the valley.

outro.text: Every seal back where it belongs. The valley sleeps tonight because of you.

quests.name: A Letter Through the Snow
quests.objective: Carry Renji's letter to Suzu in Autumn Wood

intro.text: My feet won't take me another step on this road. My sister will worry.
She's the healer in Autumn Wood. Would you carry this letter to her?

handover.text: A letter, from your brother on the frozen road.
Renji? That fool. Thank you. I'll send him something warm.

quests.name: The Five Pillars
quests.objective: Answer the five pillars, one nature at a time

intro.text: The pillars still hum. Every nature remembers the fight up here.
Answer them, one by one. Then you'll know what you've become.

outro.text: Five natures, one shinobi. I have nothing left to teach you.
